Its body is round and fluffy, giving it a soft and cuddly appearance. The ears are large and stand up straight, while the paws are small and round.

The bunny's face is round as well, featuring two black eyes that gaze upwards. A pink nose sits in the middle of its face, adding a touch of color to its white fur. On either side of its head, there are two pink ears that add to its cute appearance. The bunny's arms rest down at its sides, completing its endearing look.

Overall, the image captures the essence of this toy's charm with its adorable features and soft colors. It's a simple yet captivating scene that brings back memories of childhood.
